model.name: ServerLauncher.selfHealingStart
model.description: Self-healing npm start: re-exec under node18+, npm i if node_modules missing, kill stale port owners, build, then run the tsx server in the FOREGROUND (spawnSync stdio:inherit + process.exit(srv.status)) so it owns the controlling terminal — readline TUI + live request-log stream, never backgrounded/detached. Prereq = npm only; idempotent fresh restart.
